label: EV stock history 2014-2025
source: VAHAN4 dashboard, data/data.csv. 2026 excluded: partial year (data ends mid-2026). Pre-2014 stock ignored.

label: National curve
value: Logistic S=K/(1+exp(-r(t-t0))), r,t0 least-squares on log stock, anchored to 2025

label: Saturation stock K low/base/high
source: Not identifiable from data before the inflection. No public policy target is in our data, so none is used as an anchor.

label: District allocation
value: State share drifts by 2025 momentum over 5y; districts drift half-way to state population share by 2035
source: Assumed convergence so early-adopter districts do not compound forever.

label: Fleet mix 2W/3W/4W
source: VAHAN extract has no class split. Rough read of Indian EV registrations (2W and e-3W dominate).

label: kWh per 100 km 2W/3W/4W
source: Typical e-scooter, e-rickshaw/L5, small e-car consumption.

label: Public charging share of energy
source: Kazam/AEEE (80,000+ home installs): home is 80-90% of EV energy, so 10-20% is everything else, incl. workplace, depot, swap. 15% = midpoint; 20% is a ceiling. CEA FY26 metered energy implies 4-15% (report back-test, ours), and ~45% of buyers lack home charging, so no lower. Not ramped: no evidence on its trend.

label: Utilisation (energy-based, % of 16h at rated power)
source: 15% is a mature-network target (= 10% on 24h; IEA projects 15% for Europe by 2035, time-based). India today is 1-5% on 24h (SBI 1-3%, S&P ~5%, FICCI <2%; relayed by EMobility+/Outlook Business, originals unread) = 1.5-7.5% on 16h; 4.5% = ~3% on 24h, mid-range. Linear ramp is assumed; no source gives the path.

label: Sensitivity on chargers to add
value: low: public 10%, utilisation 21% (2035 value) | high: public 20%, utilisation 7.5% | EV path and all else = base; ramp applied to each
source: Bounds from sources: public 10-20% (Kazam/AEEE residual); utilisation 21% = ChargeZone 14% restated on 16h, 7.5% = 5% on 24h (S&P, today's ceiling held flat). Computed by re-running every district; the report's 4-46 lakh is a cross-check, not an input. EV scenarios (K) are separate, not mixed in.

label: Registered EVs: Lok Sabha vs VAHAN sum
value: Lok Sabha 1,00,23,396 (26 Jul 2026) vs our 1.08 crore: not a conflict. Our end-2025 stock 79.4 lakh + Jan-Jul 2026 RTO registrations 18.8 lakh = ~98.2 lakh at 31 Jul (~97.4 lakh at 26 Jul), within 2-3% of official.
source: data/data.csv VAHAN4 (BOV + pure EV; 2026 total 28.4 lakh runs to ~Oct 2026) and data/raw/vahan_rto/fuel.csv (HR207 excluded). The 1.08 crore is a later date, ~Aug-Oct 2026 adds ~9.6 lakh. Residual 2-3% unexplained (official may count other categories or differ in date); VAHAN not changed. Forecast is anchored on end-2025, so unaffected.

label: Rated power AC / DC30 / DC60 / DC120
source: Nominal ratings of common unit classes.

label: Energy share by type, urban
source: Dense urban favours fast DC for turnover.

label: Spacing floor
value: One charger per 2.6 x 3^2 km2 of built-up area; built-up = urban population / 5000/km2
source: Urban spacing norm (MoP 2025, see assumptions_gap.json); density assumed. Floor chargers split AC / DC30.

label: Connectors per station
source: Mean of 'connectors' where reported in data/data.csv (2,572 stations: 2.07). Converts existing stations to charge points.
